tests.name: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with ESR
tests.description: Quantitative evaluation of red blood cells, white blood cells, platelets, and erythrocyte sedimentation rate to detect infection, anemia, and inflammation.
tests.clinicalSignificance: Essential baseline investigation for detecting systemic infections, bacterial/viral illness, leukemias, allergic conditions, thrombocytopenia, and inflammatory disorders.
preparationInstructions: Stay hydrated with plain water before sample draw.

tests.name: Lipid Profile (Complete Heart & Cholesterol)
tests.description: Measures total cholesterol, good HDL cholesterol, bad LDL cholesterol, triglycerides, and VLDL to estimate cardiovascular and coronary artery disease risk.
tests.clinicalSignificance: Crucial for assessing atherosclerosis, myocardial infarction risk, hyperlipidemia, and monitoring dietary or statin drug efficacy.
preparationInstructions: Avoid high-fat meal and alcohol the evening prior to test.

tests.name: Liver Function Test (LFT Complete)
tests.description: Comprehensive biochemical assessment of liver integrity, biliary drainage, and protein synthesis.
tests.clinicalSignificance: Screens for hepatitis, fatty liver disease, cirrhosis, drug-induced hepatotoxicity, alcohol-related damage, and biliary obstruction.
preparationInstructions: 8-10 hours fasting recommended for optimal clarity.

tests.name: Kidney Function Test (KFT with eGFR)
tests.description: Evaluates glomerular filtration, nitrogenous waste excretion, urea clearance, and serum creatinine balance.
tests.clinicalSignificance: Monitors chronic kidney disease (CKD), acute kidney injury, diabetic nephropathy, hypertensive renal damage, and gout.
preparationInstructions: Avoid heavy red meat consumption right before test.

tests.name: Thyroid Profile Total (T3, T4, TSH)
tests.description: Simultaneous assessment of Triiodothyronine (T3), Thyroxine (T4), and Ultrasensitive Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (TSH).
tests.clinicalSignificance: Screens for hypothyroidism, hyperthyroidism, thyroid nodules, Hashimoto thyroiditis, unexplained weight changes, and fatigue.
preparationInstructions: Early morning sample collection is ideal due to diurnal TSH rhythm.
Inform technician if taking thyroid hormone replacement medication.

tests.name: HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin) with eAG
tests.description: Measures percentage of glycated hemoglobin to establish 3-month average blood glucose control using HPLC method.
tests.clinicalSignificance: Gold standard test for diabetes diagnosis (threshold >= 6.5%), prediabetes detection (5.7 - 6.4%), and ongoing glycemic control.
preparationInstructions: No fasting required. Can be drawn at any time of day.

tests.name: Blood Glucose (Fasting Blood Sugar / FBS)
tests.description: Enzymatic quantitative measurement of plasma glucose after an overnight fast.
tests.clinicalSignificance: Key diagnostic test for fasting hyperglycemia, impaired fasting glucose, and diabetes mellitus management.
preparationInstructions: Strict 8-10 hours overnight fasting required. Water is allowed.

tests.name: Vitamin D (25-Hydroxy / 25-OH)
tests.description: Total 25-hydroxyvitamin D measurement to assess sunshine vitamin sufficiency for bone and immune health.
tests.clinicalSignificance: Detects Vitamin D deficiency (<20 ng/mL), insufficiency, osteoporosis, rickets, muscle weakness, and fatigue.

tests.name: Vitamin B12 (Cyanocobalamin)
tests.description: Quantifies serum cobalamin levels essential for nerve conduction, memory, and erythropoiesis.
tests.clinicalSignificance: Investigates megaloblastic anemia, peripheral neuropathy, tingling sensation, memory fog, especially in vegetarians.
preparationInstructions: Overnight fasting of 8 hours is recommended.

tests.name: Urine Routine & Microscopic Examination (R/M)
tests.description: Physical, chemical strip, and sediment microscopy of urine to assess kidneys, urinary tract, and systemic metabolism.
tests.clinicalSignificance: Identifies urinary tract infections (UTI), glomerulonephritis, proteinuria, kidney stones, and glucosuria.
preparationInstructions: Collect mid-stream clean catch urine in the provided sterile container.

tests.name: Serum Calcium (Total)
tests.description: Measures total circulating calcium to evaluate bone metabolism and parathyroid gland activity.
tests.clinicalSignificance: Evaluates hypercalcemia (malignancy, hyperparathyroidism) and hypocalcemia (tetany, vitamin D deficiency, renal disease).
preparationInstructions: No strict fasting required, but avoid calcium supplements on the morning of test.

tests.name: C-Reactive Protein (CRP Quantitative)
tests.description: High sensitivity acute phase reactant produced by the liver during systemic inflammation and bacterial infection.
tests.clinicalSignificance: Rapid indicator of bacterial infections, autoimmune flare-ups (rheumatoid arthritis, lupus), and cardiovascular risk.
